description: Quiz authoring image step 3/3: the server reads the stored bytes and checks the reserved size, magic bytes, dimensions, pixel count and SHA-256 (pass expectedSha256 to cross-check) before it commits the image READY. UPLOAD_INCOMPLETE means nothing is stored yet; CHECKSUM_MISMATCH leaves the reservation PENDING; INVALID bytes need a new reservation. Then put `imageNode` into a question's rich content in the draft (form_update_draft) and set `attrs.alt` to a short description, or `attrs.decorative: true` for an image that carries no meaning. The draft accepts only READY images of the same form or job. Employer-only: needs project_todos:write (list: project_todos:read), a claimed account and access to the form's job; a missing, foreign, other-job, archived or organization-level form is one 404. Images are private: no storage path or delivery URL is returned, and bytes never travel in a request body or as base64.
name: opentrain_quiz_form_image_finalize
